description: Research source code and final Figures 1–7 for the 21 October 2026 manuscript v15. Includes standard WSE-stratified fivefold CV, unchanged hydraulic model/QC modules, product comparisons, error and station analysis, and portable plotting entry points. Numerical inputs, private predictions and the removed aggregate data directory are not distributed.
